name: Docker Tasks in GitHub Codespaces: Basics of ICT Infrastructure & Cloud Services
postCreateCommand:
set -e
# Verify Docker engine is reachable (won't fail the build if not)
(docker version && docker info) || true
# Pre-pull images so students see faster results (optional)
docker pull hello-world || true
docker pull alpine || true
docker pull dockersamples/static-site || true
